review_scope: Post-verification safety wording, report prominence and explicit replay metadata only
finding: In a conductive-bypass experiment, fault_input_kj describes the contributing erected stages. It must not be read as a measurement of the whole original bank or evidence that excluded capacitors are discharged.
correction: Mode-specific energy definitions and fault_input_scope now make excluded capacitor charge and residual energy explicitly unverified. The HTML report displays this fact prominently in its own notice.
replay_metadata: Reference exports now include nominal_efficiency and physics_version explicitly, alongside the existing effective circuit arguments and fitted parameters. The nominal loss factor differs from the effective one when a loss_scale is fitted; both must be retained for replay.
existing_results: results.json retains the completed 38-attempt numerical verification. Source hashes there identify its scoring source; the later metadata-only revision is disclosed here.
